example.error: this computer is no longer paired

notes: Refused for a row carrying unpaired_at. The sentence names the COMPUTER, not the device: a device paired only to A has no business being pushed about B, and the copy must not claim a revoke nobody performed.
expired_at does NOT refuse: authenticating and re-registering IS the act that clears it (that is why it is a different marker), and a fresh install_id is refused on nothing at all.
Precedence revoked > unpaired > expired decides which of these two a row carrying both answers with (ADR §4).
